products.name: Photoroom
products.note: AI photo editing; background removal; e-commerce focus; EU data handling

profile_text.body:
Photoroom is an AI-powered photo editing tool and listing studio aimed primarily at e-commerce businesses and social media creators. The company describes its platform as enabling users to create product and portrait images using only a phone, and offers capabilities including background removal, background replacement, object removal, clothing recoloring, image resizing, and AI-generated shadows. For larger organizations, Photoroom offers custom AI models, API access, and dedicated support intended for global teams running visual production at catalog scale. The company's site quotes a customer citing six-figure savings and a reduction of workload to a quarter through automation, though these figures are drawn from that unattributed testimonial.

The platform's background removal tool is described by the company as the fastest AI background removal available, and it reports more than 80 million users. Additional tools listed on the site include Product Staging, AI Fashion Models, Ghost Mannequin, Flat Lay, Product Beautifier, an AI Product Fixer, and a Product Video Generator, among others. Automation features cover batch editing, bulk resizing, bulk background removal, bulk positioning, and bulk file conversion, alongside a public API.

The held facts note that Photoroom handles EU data and that the platform has an associated MCP server listed in the registry, reflecting the Photoroom MCP entry visible on the company's own site. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
